title: When a notification with a context menu moves down, the context menu doesn't move.
line: A file menu opened from a screenshot notification now stays fully on screen when the notification slides down.
explanation: The thumbnail's file menu is an xdg popup attached to the notification window. When the notifications below expired and the window slid down, KWin moved the menu along with it but never ran its constraint adjustment again (Qt doesn't make the positioner reactive), so the menu ran past the bottom edge and under the panel. The menu now follows its notification with a move, which makes Qt send xdg_popup.reposition so KWin places it again (flipping it above the button or click point); the move is sent only once the frame carrying the notification's new position has been applied (one frame later), and the right-click path gets an explicit anchor at the click point, mirrored for right-to-left.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Keep the file menu on screen when the notification moves

The file menu followed its notification without being placed again, so
it ran off the screen when the notification slid down. Now it's moved
once the notification's new position is applied, so it's placed again.
